description.regularText: When you end a [TAG;Jump] Move at a flat surface you can immedatly use a [TAG;Jump] Ability at no cost but halve the distance moved. If you don’t have at least 3 [MP] or a reaction availible in your current turn you can’t perform another wall jump. Depending on surface conditions the GM might require you to perform a [AGI] Athletics [SKILL TEST].

push.effect: When you push this maneuver your pushing distance is not halved.
